newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CRT started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CRT started as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio said it started coverage of Brazilian telecommunications firm Companhia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes (CRT) with a buy rating.
-- CRT's common and preferred shares are traded in the Brazilian over-the-counter market called SOMA.
-- Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio said in a report that CRT shares are expected to be traded on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange in the first half of this year.
-- It said it believes "CRT successfully combines a favorable strategic position, strong growth and top-quality management in the Brazilian telecom industry."

-- CRT's strategic position, it added, comes from its attractive area of concession "as well as its new private shareholder, who will likely improve its technological, financial, marketing and managerial capabilities."
-- A 35 percent voting stake in the company, which is controlled by Rio Grande do Sul state government, was sold in December to a consortium led by Brazilian media group RBS and Telefonica de Espana.
